messages:
maria: FYI — embeddings service degrading for some customers. Need quick marketing decisions: statuspage copy, webinar registrant note, and pausing lead routing.

lucy: Engineering rolling back a cache change now. ETA 30-45m to validate.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-embeddings created by lucy.

priya: Status suggestion (short): 'Investigating degraded embeddings. Engineers are rolling back a recent cache change and routing traffic to a stable path. Next update in 30m. Enterprise customers: contact support@redwood.com.'

sam: Sales request: pause SFDC lead pushes and route new signups to incident-inbound@redwood.com for 1 hour. SDRs will monitor but not outreach.

maria: Also pause any scheduled benchmark posts and paid campaigns until we mark resolved. For today's webinar, send a one-line registrant DM: 'Live embedding demos paused due to platform incident — we'll reschedule within 48 hours. See status.redwood.com.'

priya: I'll send the registrant DM now and prep enterprise email template to send after recovery validation.

sam: Done: SFDC webhook paused and routing to incident-inbound.

lucy: Rolling back complete; running validation windows. If p95 improves over two windows I'll ask ops to set status to 'recovering'.

maria: Thanks — keep updates here short. I'll publish the initial statuspage copy in 10m.
